nfc23f411b3.headline: Despite headwinds, Zenith Bank’s profit after tax rises by 5% in q1 2021
nfc23f411b3.summary: Zenith Bank Nigeria announced a 5% increase in profit after tax for Q1 2021 despite macroeconomic headwinds and pandemic impacts.
nfc23f411b3.why: As one of Nigeria's leading banks, its financial performance reflects the resilience of the country's banking sector and economic conditions.

na78bc2e7ae.headline: Epidemic out of control: India records 400,000 daily confirmed cases - International news
na78bc2e7ae.summary: India recorded over 400,000 new COVID-19 infections in 24 hours, the first country to exceed that daily level. More than 40 countries pledged supplies such as oxygen concentrators and ventilators.
na78bc2e7ae.why: India is the world's second-largest population and a major growth economy, so its outbreak affects global supply chains, commodity demand and emerging-market risk sentiment.
na78bc2e7ae.why_moved: The record daily case count signals a deepening health crisis in India, raising concern about renewed restrictions and economic disruption.

neab1baa39e.headline: Martín Guzmán loses ground in the tariff dispute with Kirchnerism's interventors
neab1baa39e.summary: Argentina's energy regulator ENRE has set a single 9% increase for this year, while the Economy Ministry hopes to reach 15% with specific corrections. The Secretary of Energy is analysing all options.
neab1baa39e.why: Energy tariffs set by the regulator determine utility revenues and affect inflation and fiscal subsidies in Argentina.

n14c9a80b2e.headline: GST revenue hits all-time high of Rs 1.41 lakh-crore in April
n14c9a80b2e.summary: India's Goods and Services Tax collections reached a record high of over Rs 1.41 lakh crore in April 2021, up 14% year-on-year, indicating sustained economic recovery, according to the Finance Ministry.
n14c9a80b2e.why: GST revenue is a key indicator of economic activity and consumption in India, reflecting the health of the formal economy and government tax collections.

ne5120866b5.headline: Rolling up the sleeves: China’s tech giants drive digital yuan adoption
ne5120866b5.summary: Chinese internet, fintech, and e-commerce companies are spearheading the adoption and testing of the digital yuan as China advances its central bank digital currency deployment.
ne5120866b5.why: China’s digital yuan initiative represents a major innovation in currency technology with potential impacts on global payments, monetary policy, and financial markets.
